title: The base-seven Heraclitus transform: manuscript and reproducible proof package
description:
AI-assisted research package for the base-seven Heraclitus transform: an exact greedy walk starting at zero, using jumps 7^j for j >= 0 to unused integers, minimizing absolute value with positive preference in ties. Includes the manuscript, finite certificates, separate Python checker and generators, and a Lean formalization of the literal rule, finite base, all scale transitions and coverage of every integer.

The manuscript remains a proposed computer-assisted proof pending independent human mathematical review. The complete first-crossing deviation derivation (7)-(9) and limsup lower bound 3/8 are not formalized in Lean; equality remains unproved. No matching prior base-seven coverage result was found in the sources searched; possible overlap with unpublished work remains unresolved.
